about: E1-9: набор заглушек этапа 1 в стиле Б. Заказ — tools/art_stage1.py (ComfyUI Мака напрямую, Z-Image base, 30 шагов, cfg 4), обработка — tools/art_stage1_build.py. Перечень цветов из стилевой части убран (STYLE.md, п. 11): цвета названы в описании предмета.
style: clean hand-drawn 2D game illustration, bold confident dark plum-brown outlines of even weight around every shape, flat color fills with simple two-step cel shading and one crisp highlight, strong readable silhouette, large graphic simplified shapes, very little small detail, bright saturated sunny Mediterranean colors, smooth vector-like finish

camera.floor: a full-frame flat texture of open ground seen from straight above, like looking down at your feet, the ground continues past all four edges of the picture and is cut off by the frame, the whole picture is covered with ground, no rim, no border, no frame, no background color, no empty margin, no horizon, no perspective, no objects, no shadows, uniform even density everywhere, flat even light, no text, no letters, no watermark
camera.object: high overhead three-quarter view, top-down game camera tilted at about 45 degrees looking down at the subject like in a top-down survival crafting game, a single subject centered in the frame, the whole subject fully visible with empty margin around it, nothing cropped, key light from the upper left at 45 degrees, no cast shadow, isolated on a plain flat very light warm grey background, no ground, no grass, no scenery, no other objects, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border, no frame
camera.cliff: high overhead three-quarter view, top-down game camera tilted at about 45 degrees like in a top-down survival crafting game, key light from the upper left, no characters, no trees, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border, no frame

negative.floor: frame, border, margin, grey background, vignette, glow, light spots, objects, trees, rocks casting shadows, perspective, horizon, sky, text, watermark, blurry, photo, 3d render
